senses.gloss: ch., perf. a. part. חָב, חַב same, esp. to incur guilt, to sin.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 4:22">Targ. Lev. IV, 22</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Onkelos Numbers 15:28">Targ. O. Num. XV, 28</cite> <he>בִּמְחֲבֵיה</he> ed. Berl. (oth. ed. <he>בְּמֵחֲבֵיה</he>, <he>בְּמֶחֲ׳</he>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 34:17">Targ. Job XXXIV, 17</cite>; a. fr.—
Lam. R. to II, 1 (expl. יָעִיב, ib.) איך ח׳ וכ׳ how did the Lord … condemn &c.; there are places דצווחין לחַיָיבָא עייבא where ḥayaba (the guilty) is pronounced ͑ayaba, v. עוּב.—
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 68b:17">B. Kam. 68ᵇ</cite> <he>לא לִיחַיְּיבֵיה</he> (omitted in Ms. F.) do not condemn him (to pay a fine).

Ber. 20ᵇ וכל מ״ע נְחַיְּיבִינְהוּ וכ׳ we might just as well by rabbinical ordinance declare them subject to all positive religious duties; a. fr.—Part. pass. מְחַיַּיב (interch. with מִיחַיַּיב, v. infra).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Kings 21:16">Targ. II Kings XXI, 16</cite>; a. e.

senses.gloss: to become guilty, to be induced to sin.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Samuel 19:5">Targ. I Sam. XIX, 5</cite> (ed. Lag. <he>את מחייב</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 5:19">Targ. Y. Lev. V, 19</cite>; a. e.

senses.gloss: to be convicted, sentenced &c.; to be amenable to law, be bound.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 34:23">Targ. Ps. XXXIV, 23</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Ketubot 85a:8-9">Keth. 85ᵃ</cite> <he>ההיא … דאִיחַיְּיבָא שבועה וכ׳</he> a woman was declared bound to make oath in the court of &c.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 29a:11">R. Hash. 29ᵃ</cite> <he>מִיחַיְּיבֵי</he> are bound (subject to the law about Shofar).
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 29a:12">Ib.</cite> <he>אימא … לא לִיחַיְּיבוּ</he> I might have thought they ought not to be bound.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 72b:2">B. Kam. 72ᵇ</cite> <he>כי קא מְחַיַּיב</he> (v. supra) when does he become responsible; a. v. fr.
